history.summary: Established 99LH 3BR near Bishan MRT/interchange in a top schools belt, showing a strong 9.1%/yr URA rate but on a thin 35-txn base and at $2,094 psf — ~8% above the $1,935 median. Solid location, but a 26-year-old leasehold asking above market median caps the investment case.
history.rating_rationale: Bishan's MRT interchange, Junction 8 and elite schools (Catholic High, Raffles) give genuine liquidity and tenant demand. But the headline 9.1%/yr rests on only 35 transactions, the unit asks 8% over the $1,935 URA median, and a 99LH built in 2000 has ~73yrs lease remaining — appreciation will face lease decay over a 5-7yr hold.
red_flags: 9.1%/yr rate based on thin 35-txn series — unreliable
catalysts: Bishan MRT interchange (NS/Circle) and Junction 8 connectivity
Premier schools belt (Catholic High, Raffles Institution) supports family demand
Mature estate with deep owner-occupier buyer pool
